description: Defines data structures for E1AP bearer context management, including setup, modification, response, release, and reset commands within the ocudu::ocuup namespace.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request
classes.description: Request to create a new UE and bearer context.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_setup_response
classes.description: Response to a bearer context setup request, including UE index and session lists.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
classes.description: Request to modify an existing bearer context.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_modification_response
classes.description: Response to a bearer context modification request, including session status lists.

classes.name: e1ap_bearer_context_release_command
classes.description: Command to release a bearer context with cause.

classes.name: e1ap_reset
classes.description: Reset command for UE contexts, either full or partial.
